title: Find XOR Sum of All Pairs Bitwise AND
summary: The XOR sum of a list is the bitwise XOR of all its elements.
statement: The XOR sum of a list is the bitwise XOR of all its elements. For a single-element list, the XOR sum is the element itself. Given two arrays arr1 and arr2, compute the XOR sum of the list formed by the bitwise AND of every pair (arr1[i], arr2[j]).
constraints: Form the bitwise AND for every cross-array pair and XOR all results.
reference_solution:
def xor_sum_of_pairwise_and(arr1, arr2):
 left=right=0
 for value in arr1:left^=value
 for value in arr2:right^=value
 return left&right

def xor_sum_of_pairwise_and(arr1, arr2):
 left=right=0
 for value in arr1:left^=value
 for value in arr2:right|=value
 return left&right
hints: XOR every value in each array separately.
Expanding the distributive identity produces every pairwise AND term exactly once, and XOR parity cancels repeated bit contributions correctly.
editorial: Expanding the distributive identity produces every pairwise AND term exactly once, and XOR parity cancels repeated bit contributions correctly.

tests.explanation: The XOR of all six pairwise AND values is zero.
The single pair contributes 12 AND 4, which is four.
